original: indriyāṇi, viṣayā, buddhayaśca duḥśasādhanabhāvāt| sukhamapi duḥkhānuṣaṅgāt duḥkham| duḥkhaṃ tu yātanāpīḍāsantāpātmakaṃ mukhyata eva duḥkhamiti| duḥkhahānañcātyantikī duḥkhotpattinivṛttiḥ| tasyopāya ātmaviṣayakaṃ tattvajñānam| tathā ca śrutiḥ - `ātmā vā are draṣṭava......tarati śokamātmavit' ityādiḥ|
analyzed: indriyāṇi viṣayāḥ buddhayaḥ ca duḥśa sādhana bhāvāt sukham api duḥkha anuṣaṅgāt duḥkham duḥkham tu yātanā pīḍā santāpa ātmakam mukhyatas eva duḥkham iti duḥkha hānam ca ātyantikī duḥkha utpatti nivṛttiḥ tasya upāyaḥ ātma viṣayakam tattva jñānam tathā ca śrutiḥ ātmā vai are śokam ātma vid ityādiḥ

original: sṛṣṭau mahadādīnāṃ svārthābhāvaḥ - sṛṣṭirhi puruṣārthā bhavati ato mahadādayo na svārthāya sṛṣṭimārabhante| prakṛtestu nityatvāt tasyāḥ svārthāyārabhyo yujyate| mahādādīnāntu anityatvāt kāraṇalayena nāśāt sṛṣṭimātraṃ na tu kaścit svārthaḥ |
